verdict.rationale: pnpm is a documented CLI (pnpm-probe-4) that can install and update dependencies without prompts in automation. It auto-detects CI and switches to frozen-lockfile mode, and it fails the install when the lockfile needs an update, when an offline package is missing, or when a workspace: version is unresolvable. It also offers dry-run and lockfile-only modes an agent can use to preview or limit changes. The 'fails' language implies non-zero exits, but the evidence never documents exit codes, the format or clarity of error messages, or an explicit non-interactive flag outside CI detection. missing for 10: documented exit-code semantics, evidence of clear or structured error output for install/update failures, an explicit non-interactive mode for agents outside CI, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven installs
